avoid_dishes.reason: Bulgogi marinade and tomato ponzu, both soy-based
Tortilla/crust base and umami aioli are likely to contain gluten
Wheat; gochujang often contains wheat or barley

name: Akira Back Dubai
questions: Do you have a separate gluten-free menu?
Is gochujang, bulgogi or ponzu GF in any dish?
summary: There are reports of a GF menu, but they're unconfirmed. Most signatures use soy, gochujang or ponzu.
tamari_source: One GF guide says it has 'separate gluten-free menus', and FMGF lists it on its Dubai sushi page. A hotel listing tags it gluten-free. I found no first-party confirmation or tamari mention. The allergen-marked Akira Back PDF I found appears to be another property's menu (OOMB).
